```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE)
```

Use **gbase** to prepare a Glist that selects database markers through integer
positions in the original BED files. Keep the original BED/BIM/FAM files.

```{r download}
library(gbase)
library(gact)

GAlist <- readRDS("C:/Users/gact/hsa.0.0.1/GAlist_hsa.0.0.1.rds")
GAlist <- downloadDB(GAlist=GAlist, what="1000G")
```

Prepare and save one descriptor per ancestry. This applies the website's
database-availability selection, without adding another QC filter.
Read marker IDs from BIM before preparation: `gprep()` computes genotype
summaries from BED, so preparing the whole panel just to discover IDs performs
an unnecessary scan and creates a potentially large intermediate descriptor.

```{r prepare}
nthreads <- 1L  # Increase only to the number of cores available to this job.
for (ancestry in c("eur", "eas", "sas")) {
  prefix <- file.path(GAlist$dirs["marker"], paste0("g1000_", ancestry))
  message(ancestry, ": reading BIM marker IDs")
  bim_ids <- data.table::fread(paste0(prefix, ".bim"), header=FALSE,
    select=2L, colClasses="character")[[1L]]
  rsids <- bim_ids[bim_ids %in% GAlist$rsids]
  if (!length(rsids)) stop("No database markers in the ", ancestry, " panel")
  message(ancestry, ": preparing ", length(rsids), " selected markers")
  print(system.time(Glist <- gbase::gprep(study=paste("1000G", toupper(ancestry)),
    bedfiles=paste0(prefix, ".bed"), bimfiles=paste0(prefix, ".bim"),
    famfiles=paste0(prefix, ".fam"), rsids=rsids, nthreads=nthreads)))
  message(ancestry, ": saving descriptor")
  print(system.time(saveRDS(Glist, file.path(GAlist$dirs["marker"],
    paste0("Glist_1000G_", ancestry, "_filtered.rds")))))
  rm(Glist, bim_ids, rsids)
  gc(verbose=FALSE)
  message(ancestry, ": done")
}
```

Preparation reads selected BED genotypes to compute counts and allele
frequencies; it does not compute LD. Threading applies to the genotype count
scan, not all metadata preparation. The stage messages distinguish preparation
from the default gzip-compressed RDS write. `compress=FALSE` can make the latter
faster at the cost of a larger descriptor file. Large-panel runtime also depends
on storage throughput and memory pressure; small fixtures do not establish
whole-genome performance.

Continue with [sparse LD and LD scores](Compute_sparseLD_1000G.html).
Older qgg descriptors should be prepared again with gbase using their existing
BED/BIM/FAM paths; genotype data need not be downloaded again.
